cohort: Women who underwent incisional hernia repair between January 2010 and December 2020 at two tertiary hospitals in Enugu, Nigeria.
finding: Caesarean section and obesity were frequently associated with incisional hernia, but there was no statistically significant relationship between incisional hernia and obesity (p=0.446).
mod_finding: Caesarean section was the most frequently performed laparotomy (67.5%) among participants with incisional hernia.
